items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: they were a bunch of guys that that was the Colonel Tippett and the Elona Gay with the atomic bomb on it

ctx.x: Bobby Troup, right. And he was in charge of the black troops, which were the service group. They would straighten the planes out and load them up with whatever bombs. I remember being on Tinian when the Seabees left and the new group came in and took over their barracks and they had a wonderful mess hall fixed you, because the Seabees were doing all the building, and usually the outfit that was on an island longest would replace the Seabees as a camp. They would get their camp. This was a whole new outfit and…
They were just doing their job.
